stage: server plan only: independent target score geometry, no training
checkpoint: operator supplies frozen base model plus original trained LoRA adapter, if applicable; checkpoint and step recorded before measurement
parameter_scope: exact original trainable thought-update parameter scope; do not silently create a random LoRA adapter or switch to full-model gradients
selection: unique independent holdout IDs sorted by salted SHA256, salt score-geometry-v1; no score/reward conditioning
smoke_prompts: first4 of the frozen128; tooling verification only
replay: reuse checkpoint-aligned complete processed replay if available; otherwise declare generation settings before generating one frozen replay per selected prompt
group: four thoughts per prompt for standalone K4 diagnostic; also preserve actual full global normalization-group IDs if using training replay
continuations: first stored continuation per thought for score; preserve M and original segment boundaries; extra answer samples not needed when exact replay already exists
gradient: mean-log-prob over shifted thought-token mask, model.eval, ratio1, no optimizer step; excludes answer and KL and post-update clipping

generation_fallback.temperature: must be filled from actual frozen checkpoint training_args.json before generation; no implicit default

invalid_handling: retain selected IDs and report failures; do not replace invalid or high-cost samples; zero mask gives zero score with explicit flag; incomplete groups cannot enter primary geometry summary
decision: descriptive problem-anchor audit only; no automatic method/training GO, synthetic5percent screen stays failed
execution_budget: four-prompt smoke first; project128-prompt cost from measured time/peak VRAM; user uses their server; stop on incomplete replay or normalization mismatch
OOM_rule: microbatch thought score forwards while preserving all selected sequences and parameter coordinates; never shorten thought/image limits or drop groups silently
implementation_status: preflight and prompt-freeze CLIs available; target replay capture, score export and measurement analyzer are not yet implemented
